chunks: 1467 - And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"It is not appropriate for the prayer of the two Eids to be performed in a roofed mosque, nor in a house; rather, it is performed in the open desert or in an exposed place."

key_terms.الصَّحْرَاءِ: the open desert or open-air land
key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْعِيدَيْنِ: the prayer of the two Eids, namely Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
key_terms.مَكَانٍ بَارِزٍ: an open, visible, and exposed place

ai.seo_question: Where should the Eid prayer be performed according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the place of salat for the two Eids. It states that Eid prayer should not be held in a covered mosque or a house, but rather in an open and outward place such as the desert or an exposed area.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1467 - Ali ibn Ri'ab narrated from Abu Basir from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
"It is not appropriate for the Eid prayers to be performed in a covered mosque or in a house; rather, they should be prayed in the open air or in an exposed place."
